symptom_plain: Grinding or scraping noise when braking
likely_causes_ranked: Worn brake pads; scored rotors; stuck caliper
quick_checks: Check pad thickness through the wheel spokes; listen for noise only when braking
parts_involved: Front brake pad set; Rear brake pad set; Front brake rotor

symptom_plain: Clicking sound but engine will not start
likely_causes_ranked: Weak or dead battery; corroded battery terminals; failing starter
quick_checks: Check dashboard lights are bright; inspect terminals for white or green corrosion; try a jump-start

symptom_plain: Steering wheel shakes at highway speed
likely_causes_ranked: Unbalanced wheels; worn tie rod; warped front rotors (if the shake is worse when braking)
quick_checks: Note speed range where shaking starts; check tire wear pattern

likely_causes_ranked: Uneven tire pressure; wheel alignment; stuck brake caliper
quick_checks: Check all four tire pressures; check whether one wheel is hot after driving

symptom_plain: Check engine light is on and steady
likely_causes_ranked: Loose gas cap; worn spark plugs; faulty oxygen sensor
quick_checks: Tighten gas cap and drive 20 miles; have codes read. A FLASHING light means stop driving

likely_causes_ranked: Clogged cabin air filter; failing blower motor
quick_checks: Check cabin filter for dirt and debris; test all fan speeds
Inspect rubber edge for cracks; clean windshield and blades

symptom_plain: One headlight is dim or out
quick_checks: Swap in a known good bulb; check the headlight fuse

likely_causes_ranked: Dirty engine air filter; worn spark plugs; fuel delivery issue
quick_checks: Inspect engine air filter for dirt; note whether the check engine light is on
parts_involved: Engine air filter; Spark plug set

symptom_plain: Rattling from under the rear seat
quick_checks: Lift the rear seat cushion and check whether the battery moves

likely_causes_ranked: Cannot determine from this description; ask when it happens, where it comes from, and what it sounds like
quick_checks: Ask follow-up questions before suggesting any part
